Whether the referent answered this collision

collision_answered.Rd

The answer is the row's distinct_username, decided on 2026-10-27: the referent pastes the proposal they were sent there when the account that holds the composed name is somebody else, and the round then creates an account under the proposal, as it creates one for absent. It answers that proposal and no other: compared, folded on both sides, with the proposal the resolution has just made, so a proposal that moved (the name changed, or the suffix was taken meanwhile) leaves the answer standing for nothing until the new one is pasted.

Usage

collision_answered(register, resolutions)

Arguments

register

The register as read, carrying distinct_username.

resolutions

What resolve_identity() answered for each row, in the order of register.

Value

A logical vector, one answer per row.

Details

The value is never the name created, nor a name the row resolves to. The name is the proposal the round found free in this sweep, and the field only says yes to it; on every verdict but collision nobody reads it.

Pure, and only half of the question: whether the answer was written after the proposal it names is the log's to say, log_answer_stands().
